[[File:Forceunleashedevo.jpg|thumb|right|An EVO Trooper with a FA-3 flechette launcher]]
The '''FA-3 flechette launcher''' was a [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech]] flechette rifle that fired tiny shards of metal that were deadly in close quarters, capable of hitting many targets and ricocheting off surfaces. It was originally designed for the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to facilitate [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[EVO trooper]]s were known to carry them into battle. EVO trooper armor could absorb electrical discharges and redirect it to their FA-3 flechette launcher to produce a powerful stun blast.
